catastrophe.name: The Fracture
catastrophe.cause: Nuclear war shattered Earth into floating islands.

geography.landform: Fractured continents and floating rock islands above an atmospheric void
geography.boundaries: Map labels mark regions of influence, not surveyed borders.

magnetic_fields.behavior: Erratic and turbulent in motion, but their patterns are predictable.
magnetic_fields.navigation: Ships use magnetic motors to travel through the fields between cities and mining sites.

humanity.adaptation: Survivors evolved over generations under the influence of the magnetic fields.

gravity_and_energy.city_support: Magneton technology stabilizes floating cities and islands, preventing them from falling.
gravity_and_energy.local_gravity: Generated local fields reproduce the experience of the old Earth’s gravity.
gravity_and_energy.power: Oppositely polarized metal components move in magnetic motors, powering city and transport systems.
gravity_and_energy.fictional_physics: These are rules of the setting; no real-world scientific mechanism is established.

properties: Most malleable of the Magneton types
Impenetrable and impervious to any weapons

characters.name: Idris Vale
characters.title: Captain

visual_concept.appearance: Tall dark-skinned human man, close-cropped black curls, short full black beard, navy naval coat with crimson collar and rolled cuffs, modest bronze fittings. No silver armour.

characters.uniform_standard: Navy officer coat over crimson cloth, restrained bronze fittings. Ordinary naval officer, not a new Type C armour set.

visual_concept.appearance: Human merchant guards in dark teal working coats, ordinary bronze equipment, canonical cyan Glassmere banner. Small mechanical trading Zeppelin, not a capital ship.

objects.name: New Frontier’s repainted prizes
objects.description: Josephine, Serenity and Serendipity AFTER the page20 dock repairs and quick recolouring. Three standard round-prowed Bastion capital ships, now with CRIMSON painted hull panels, bronze structural ribs and SILVER Veymarch broken-shield/star insignia. They keep their original hull shapes, standard guns and distinguishing tower/engine arrangements; do NOT become three wedge-prowed Argonaut copies or gain its huge refit cannons. Fresh paint/repair crews can be shown during the dock montage.
constraints: Exactly three prizes, plus the original Argonaut only if the shot explicitly calls for the whole fleet of FOUR.
The old fleet reference supplies hull geometry only; replace Auric gold/navy flags with crimson/silver Veymarch flags after repainting.

Compose for the fixed holder. Do not letterbox or paste the old wide image.

Floating-island backgrounds must have deliberately varied asymmetric silhouettes, geology, heights, scale and land use. Mix broad fractured mesas, thin tilted slabs, split rock spires and bare rubble, with open sky between them. Some fragments are uninhabited or vegetated; not every island carries an identical castle. Never tile, mirror or repeat the same inverted-cone island/city silhouette. Preserve a named location’s defining geography when changing camera angle.

Idris takes ONE Serenity against Glassmere and peacefully recovers some moorings; Tomas takes ONE Serendipity against Ironveil but struggles against fast schooners. Four owned capital ships total, no new ships captured. Show only requested craft.
One Bastion per dispatch: Idris/Serenity versus Glassmere, Tomas/Serendipity versus Ironveil. Four owned capitals still; only show ships requested in shot.
Glassmere gives up SOME trading moorings peacefully. Ironveil remains fast and elusive; no final conquest or destroyed capital.
Flags: Veymarch crimson/SILVER shield star, Glassmere cyan/WHITE crystal, Ironveil steel/SILVER hammer-anvil. No inverted house palettes.

All airborne vessels are rigid mechanical bronze/metal Zeppelin-like ships. ANY wooden sailing boats or cloth sails seen in an old scene reference are obsolete errors: REPLACE them with small bronze Zeppelin commuter hulls, keeping background positions.

PURPOSE: Regenerate ONE comic illustration for FIXED holder 400.00 by 350.00 logical pixels, aspect 1.1429:1. NEAR SQUARE. Requested output 1088x960. Do NOT resize or redesign the holder. Paint a NEW composition for it, not a framed photo.

SCENE: ONE round-prowed standard Bastion SERENITY in crimson panels/bronze ribs with SILVER Veymarch shield/star hovers near an outer trade mooring, guns silent, no muzzle flashes or damage. Idris Vale in foreground on mooring receives a small brass mooring key from an ordinary teal-coated Glassmere dock official. Exactly ONE smaller bronze twin-hull Caravan trader in distance withdrawing, cyan/WHITE crystal Glassmere pennant. No fighting, surrender executions, new capital ship capture or wholesale Glassmere conquest. Big Serenity clear but leave room for the peaceful two-person handoff. Sparse irregular limestone slabs, no repeated castle islands.
CAMERA: Use a clear, tightly composed shot with the important action filling the aperture; do not copy the old wide framing.

STYLE: Magneton graphic novel: painted ink, tactile bronze machinery, silver Type C, crimson Veymarch cloth, navy/gold Auric Reach uniforms; atmospheric floating islands. Consistent with supplied scene references, not photorealistic.
